Team / Leah,

Quick weekly pulse after Friday's run: I pulled the MAP and the latest eval results and highlighted the near-term items that will gate the POC acceptance. Goal here is to keep the week simple: unblock the security evidence, confirm acceptance checks, and lock the artifact handoff for the trial dataset.

Summary (short):
- Acceptance path: feature parity smoke -> latency <= 250ms p95 on small-batch -> stability for 48h under 10rps
- Current blockers: SOC2 artifact for infra, cascading test dataset formatting, a missing eval criteria row for "embedding drift" in the document
- Immediate asks: security point-of-contact + one engineering owner for dataset prep + confirm a short canary window (48h)

Action register (owners / target):
1) Provide SOC2 evidence excerpt to Cascadia — Owner: Karthik Iyer — Due: 2027-06-09  EOD
2) Finalize eval criteria spreadsheet (add embedding drift row + pass thresholds) — Owner: Marissa Cole — Due: 2027-06-09  noon
3) Deliver sanitized test dataset + README (schema & sample lines) — Owner: Ben Carter — Due: 2027-06-10
4) Schedule 30m go/no-go canary review if items 1–3 complete — Owner: Jonas Weber — Target window: 2027-06-11 to 2027-06-13

Attachments: mutual-action-plan_v1.3.xlsx, eval-criteria_vC.docx, test-dataset-readme.txt (attached).

Notes: keep replies short — if you are owning an item, reply with "OWN" and a one-line status. Leah, can you confirm the acceptance checks above map to Cascadia's internal acceptance board? If anything is missing, note the missing criteria and we'll add it to the eval sheet.

Thanks,
Jonas

Jonas,

Thanks for the clear register — helpful. Quick responses from our side:
- Acceptance checks: the three bullets you listed map well, but our security team added a requirement for "data residency attestations" on the test dataset manifest (a one-line field in the README) — can you confirm the README will include that?
- SOC2: I can escalate the request but our procurement will need a concise excerpt (SOC2 Type II report page with control mappings). We prefer a PDF snippet rather than full report distribution.
- Embedding drift: yes, that's critical. We track a cosine-threshold baseline; can Marissa propose a threshold?

Blockers:
- We hit a schema mismatch on the sample dataset — our ingestion pipeline requires a 'customer_region' column; the sample was missing it.
- We need a short list of remedial steps that the Redwood team will run during the 48h canary (e.g., restart cadence, KV cache warm-up, sample queries).

If we can get the SOC2 snippet + updated README + short canary playbook by 6/10, procurement will approve the trial window. I can do a quick review on 6/10 morning (PST).

Cheers,
Leah Morris
Head of Data Programs, Cascadia Retail

OWN: eval criteria update (Marissa)

Thanks — I added an "embedding drift" row to eval-criteria_vC.docx and proposed a first-pass threshold: cosine similarity drop >0.08 over baseline triggers an investigation. If Leah can validate or suggest a different cutoff, we'll lock it.

Canary playbook (short, 6 steps) — draft below; will drop into the Drive folder and reference in the MAP:
1) Warm KV cache with 100 representative prompts (run once)
2) Ramp traffic from 0.5rps -> 10rps over 30 minutes
3) Monitor p95 latency and error rate; if p95 > 350ms OR error rate > 1% for 5m, rollback to previous model snapshot
4) Run a 30-query accuracy sample set; compare to baseline embeddings similarity metric
5) Capture logs + sample responses and upload to Drive folder (link in MAP)
6) Post-canary sync: 30m call to triage findings and finalize acceptance

I'll also add the 'customer_region' column requirement to the test-dataset-readme.txt and include a short sample line. Attaching the updated eval doc to this thread (eval-criteria_vC.docx - revised).

-Marissa
